capture.key: capture pressure ADVANCING (weak security, poor prosperity)
capture.text: Criminal money is reaching the officials of {settlement} one at a time, because the town is poor and its streets are badly watched, and a bribe goes a long way here.

capture.key: capture pressure ADVANCING (weak security, poor prosperity)
capture.text: Each season it gets easier to buy an official at {settlement}: the town stays poor, the streets stay badly guarded, and nobody in the {seat} is mending either.

capture.key: capture pressure ADVANCING (weak security, poor prosperity)
capture.text: Officials at {settlement} are spending money their posts never paid them, and nobody in the town asks where it came from.
The criminals at {settlement} are losing their grip on the hall: the town is doing well again and its streets are guarded.
The approach was made at {settlement} and did not take. Prosperity and a working watch did what no investigation did.
The criminals at {settlement} still own a few officials, but keeping them bought now costs more than it brings in.

capture.key: capture pressure ADVANCING (weak security, poor prosperity)
capture.text: The criminal interest at {settlement} is gaining ground inside the hall rather than outside it; a poorly-paid, poorly-policed town is cheap to buy into and this one is both.

capture.key: capture pressure ADVANCING (weak security, poor prosperity)
capture.text: Each season at {settlement} makes the next approach easier. The conditions that would resist it are the same conditions the town has been failing to maintain.

capture.key: capture pressure ADVANCING (weak security, poor prosperity)
capture.text: Money is being spent at {settlement} on people who cannot account for having it, and the accounting is not being asked for.
What the criminal interest held at {settlement} it is losing; a town that pays its people and polices its streets becomes expensive to hold, and this one has become both.
What the criminal interest at {settlement} still holds it holds at a rising cost, and the cost is rising faster than what the holding returns.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, perimeter AND organized force
beast.text: The country around {settlement} is thick with creatures and the town has answered it properly: there is a wall to hold and there are people to hold it, and both are in use constantly.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, perimeter AND organized force
beast.text: Defense at {settlement} is not an emergency arrangement, it is the week's work: the rotations run, the gates close on time, and nobody treats any of it as unusual.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, perimeter AND organized force
beast.text: {settlement}'s walls and fighters are holding against the creatures, but each season wears them down, and the town is barely keeping up.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, perimeter but NO force to hold it
beast.text: {settlement}'s duty list has names enough to man its wall for one night and no longer, and in this country the creatures do not come for one night only.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, perimeter but NO force to hold it
beast.text: Walk {settlement}'s wall and you find long stretches in good repair with nobody on them, in country thick with creatures.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, perimeter but NO force to hold it
beast.text: The works at {settlement} are doing less each season as the watch thins, and the thinning is not being reversed.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, NO perimeter and NO force
beast.text: An embattled country and nothing organized standing in it: {settlement} has no line, no force and no specialist recourse, and survival here rests on terrain, distance and the ability to leave.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, NO perimeter and NO force
beast.text: The town does not defend itself. What it does is watch, and move, and hope the pressure goes around it, and that is understood by everyone in it.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, NO perimeter and NO force
beast.text: Visitors to {settlement} sense the danger before anyone mentions it: there is no wall, no organised defence, and nothing arranged to meet what comes out of the country.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: frontier, credible deterrence
beast.text: The tally of raids at {settlement} is short for a frontier town: with a wall and armed people behind it, most of what comes out of the wild country turns back before it reaches the houses.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: frontier, credible deterrence
beast.text: The town takes the frontier seriously and has taken it seriously long enough that the arrangements are ordinary rather than anxious.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: frontier, credible deterrence
beast.text: Very little reaches {settlement} out of the wild country, and the reason is that the arrangements are visible from a long way off.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: frontier, force without a perimeter
beast.text: {settlement} keeps armed people on an open frontier, which means the defense is reactive: whatever comes chooses where the fighting happens, and the town arrives afterwards.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: frontier, force without a perimeter
beast.text: You see spears at {settlement} and no wall for them to stand on, so anything that came at the town from two sides at once would get in.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: frontier, force without a perimeter
beast.text: People at {settlement} can drive off what attacks but cannot stop it arriving, so every season the town loses something before its fighters get there.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: settled, defenses beyond the need
beast.text: There is very little in the country around {settlement} and there are substantial works facing it; whatever the walls here are for, it is not the creatures.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: settled, defenses beyond the need
beast.text: {settlement} is comfortably over-provided against beasts. The pressures that matter to this town are internal, and its defensive spending does not reflect that.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: settled, defenses beyond the need
beast.text: You notice the perimeter at {settlement} chiefly for how relaxed the people on it are: there is little out in the country for them to guard against.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: settled, defenses beyond the need
beast.text: {settlement} built more against the country than the country ever asked for, and the threat now at hand is spending that margin.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: settled, defenses beyond the need
beast.text: You find {settlement}'s works manned in earnest now; what was built against nothing in particular is being held against something real.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: settled, nothing organized
beast.text: {settlement} keeps no organized defense against the country, and in a heartland this quiet the arrangement is a reasonable one rather than a gap.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: settled, nothing organized
beast.text: The town has never needed to think about what is outside it, and does not.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: settled, nothing organized
beast.text: Whoever walks out of {settlement}, in any direction and at any hour, meets nothing that would justify a watch.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: settled, nothing organized
beast.text: {settlement} kept no defence because the country never asked for one, and the country is asking now; the town is improvising what it never built.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: settled, nothing organized
beast.text: Nothing at {settlement} was organized against the country, and the threat now at hand has found the gap.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, perimeter AND organized force
beast.text: What {settlement} has built is holding against the pressure and is being spent doing it; the posture is survivable, and survivable is the most that can be said of it here.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, perimeter but NO force to hold it
beast.text: {settlement} has a wall and nobody to man it. The line is a chokepoint on paper and a chokepoint requires people standing in it, which this town cannot supply for more than a night.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, perimeter but NO force to hold it
beast.text: A stranger walks the perimeter at {settlement} and finds long stretches of good work with nobody on them, in a country where that matters a great deal.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: plagued, NO perimeter and NO force
beast.text: A stranger arriving at {settlement} understands the danger before anybody explains it, because nothing about the place is arranged as though danger were expected to be met.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: frontier, credible deterrence
beast.text: {settlement} sits on an active frontier with a line and a force behind it. Most of what comes out of the country will not press a defended perimeter, and most of what comes here does not.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: frontier, force without a perimeter
beast.text: A stranger finds spears at {settlement} and no wall for them to stand on, and can see how that would go against anything that arrived in more than one place.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: frontier, force without a perimeter
beast.text: The town can answer trouble and cannot prevent it, and the difference costs it something every season.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: settled, defenses beyond the need
beast.text: A stranger notices the perimeter at {settlement} chiefly for how relaxed the people on it are.

beast.key: Beasts & Monsters: settled, nothing organized
beast.text: A stranger walks out of {settlement} in any direction at any hour and meets nothing that would justify a watch.

rel.text: Faith carries real weight in {settlement}'s money. What the religious houses take in and spend is a large part of the town's business.
The religious houses at {settlement} are among its biggest buyers and employers, and a bad year for them is a bad year for the town.

mag.key: INCOME WEIGHT: the practice of magic
mag.text: Magic carries real weight in {settlement}'s money. What the town's practitioners charge for, and what they buy, is a large part of its business.

mag.key: INCOME WEIGHT: the practice of magic
mag.text: The people who work magic at {settlement} are among its biggest buyers and employers, and much of the town's trade turns on their custom.
